svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut perfboard to 20 x 12 mm (8 x 5 holes); file the edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front (lid side): the 12 mm tact switch, centred, with its 9.4 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: round cap; the cap stands 1 mm out of the lid when fitted.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back: five 1 kohm divider resistors, the P-MOSFET that switches

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the sensor supply, the motor N-MOSFET and its diode.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top edge: solder the tail connector's adapter board by its pin

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: row, standing up, latch to the lid side, opening upward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wire it as the wiring picture shows, 30 AWG silicone wire, with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each wire 25 mm long so the board lifts out for checking.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: foam tape on the back; it sits on the cell above the module,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 0.3 mm above it, with the cap through the lid's 10 mm hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the switch clicks through the cap; no joint stands more
